**Finding submitted: deviation (IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data), confidence 0.82.**

What I found across the document:
- **§ 2(d) (p0029)** is the only ownership clause and runs solely in TrueLink's favour (retains ownership of the Interface) — acceptable as vendor pre-existing IP, so I treated that element as already met.
- **§ 2(a)–(c) (p0022, p0028)**: our licence is a non-exclusive right to *use the Interface* that expires on termination — not perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide or sublicensable, so the fallback licence elements fail too.
- **§ 10(c) (p0065)**: "all results of the Hosting and Support Services" are only *deemed Client Proprietary Information* — a confidentiality label, not ownership.
- **§ 13 (p0078)**: Client ownership of domains and Client Content only "[i]n case of discontinued Service" — no general data-ownership statement.
- **§ 8(d) (p0054)**: a broad licence out of narrowly defined archived Credit Data — noted in the rationale but not flagged, since it is a licence rather than an assignment and does not displace our retained rights.

Cure: one inserted § 2(e) carrying only the eight preferred elements (ownership + assignment of work product, perpetual/irrevocable/royalty-free licence to embedded TrueLink IP, retention of our data, no joint ownership), leaving § 2(d) and all other text intact.
